points.description: States FALSE (the process is not always rescheduled immediately after the interrupt handler).
Justification: another process may be scheduled next instead, e.g. because the time slice of the interrupted process expired (or the scheduler picks a different process).
points.partial_credit: Half credit if justification says the CPU may not return to the same process but gives no or a vague reason.

rubric.notes: Full marks: says False and explains that a different process can be scheduled next (e.g. time slice expired). Give part marks if False is stated with a vague or incomplete reason. Zero if the answer says True, or if False has no justification (no correct justification, no marks).
